original_test_intent: Ensure every expected OAM_5 sensor remains present, healthy and consistently represented across Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Use the approved OAM_5 physical identity and expected population, collect all four interfaces at synchronized times, distinguish absence from unavailable state, normalize units/status and evaluate deltas and logs.
manual_activity: GPU/platform owner confirms the OAM_5 expected population and absence semantics and adjudicates discrepancies.
required_inputs: Expected sensor list for installed module and firmware
Secure BMC/DUT access and Web reference
safety_requirements: Do not substitute zero for missing or unavailable
Stop if module identity or sensor semantics are unresolved
agent_execution_scope: Collect Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and Web data
Account for every expected OAM_5 sensor
Normalize approved values/states and compute deltas
Report omissions and discrepancies without verdict
engineer_actions: Review missing/unavailable sensors and log context

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It reaches a relevant Redfish resource but omits mandatory IPMI/ROCm/Web checks and cannot identify silently missing sensors.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Against an approved OAM_5 population, securely capture all four views and evaluate presence, state, freshness, units and value agreement for every physical sensor.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_5 and all source-named interfaces stay within the original 5/5-minute read-only scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Start with expected sensors as table rows, then fill each interface's raw name/value/state/time so omission is evidence rather than disappearing from an inner join.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Provides completeness accounting and precise absent-state handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not broaden to power accuracy or stress response.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware may intentionally add sensors; extras must be recorded and reviewed, not automatically failed or ignored.

project_override_considerations: Platform owner defines OAM_5 population for this hardware/firmware combination and dispositions added, removed or disabled sensors.
expected_evidence: Approved OAM_5 identity and expected population
Logs, extra/missing dispositions, cleanup and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master procedure and criteria agree on OAM_5 multi-plane sensor parity; historical automation is only incomplete.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Population, mapping, tools and user confirmation can be supplied.

review_improvement: Uses expected-population-first reconciliation so missing OAM_5 sensors cannot be removed by the comparison itself.
independent_technical_reasoning: An inner join of only reported sensor names can show perfect agreement while a failed or removed channel is absent from every surface. The comparison must begin with the expected OAM_5 population and preserve absent, unavailable, disabled and error as different states. Newly added sensors also require explicit disposition because they may reveal firmware drift or incomplete baseline maintenance.
